The world is changing fast. AI is reshaping how organizations operate, innovate, and connect – and
redefining what effective cybersecurity looks like on a global scale.

With longstanding deep security expertise and clear market leadership, Trend Micro leads across that
shift – from securing critical assets to advancing mobility and protecting modern digital life –
**at every layer of the digital ecosystem**.

Setting the standard in cybersecurity for **25,000 enterprise organizations across 185 countries**,
today Trend Micro operates as the publicly listed parent organization behind a focused portfolio of
cybersecurity businesses, each serving distinct customers, markets, and needs.

[red globe]

## Where security meets what’s next

The world is changing fast. AI is reshaping how organizations operate, innovate, and connect – and
redefining what effective cybersecurity looks like on a global scale.

With longstanding deep security expertise and clear market leadership, Trend Micro leads across that
shift – from securing critical assets to advancing mobility and protecting modern digital life –
**at every layer of the digital ecosystem**.

Setting the standard in cybersecurity for **25,000 enterprise organizations across 185 countries**,

cybersecurity businesses, each serving distinct customers, markets, and needs.
* [ Financial and investor information ][56]
* [ Investor inquires ][57]

### “TrendAI™ is the global leader in AI security, setting the standard for how organizations
### protect and accelerate AI adoption. We empower organizations to embrace AI securely,
### transforming security into a driver of speed, confidence, and growth.”

**– Rachel Jin**

Chief Platform and Business Officer

[trendAI]
[trendai logo]

### AI fearlessly with TrendAI™

TrendAI™ is the enterprise security business of Trend Micro and the undisputed leader in AI
security, with unmatched platform security expertise.

Forged from industry-defining security leadership, it delivers intelligence-driven platform security
designed to manage real AI risks, simplify operations, and empower organizations to innovate with
confidence across complex environments. Enterprises across the globe rely on TrendAI™ to stay ahead
of AI-driven threats, eliminate risk at scale, and maintain clarity and control as AI reshapes
modern environments.
* [ Stay ahead, stay secure ][58]

[trendlife]
[trendlife logo]

### Protect your digital life everywhere with TrendLife™

Protect your devices, identity, and privacy at home and on mobile with smart security that keeps
your family safe from evolving threats – wherever you are.
* [ Secure your digital life ][59]

[trendlife]

Get to know our

### Executive leadership

Trend Micro’s executive leadership team is responsible for corporate strategy, financial
stewardship, and portfolio governance.
* [ See executive leadership ][60]

Meet the

### Board of directors

Trend Micro is governed by an experienced Board of Directors responsible for oversight, strategy,
and shareholder interests.
* [ See board of directors ][61]

About Trend Micro

Trend Micro is a publicly listed global cybersecurity company with a worldwide footprint.

As the parent company of a focused portfolio of security businesses, it provides governance, shared
services, and strategic investment to support long-term growth in an AI-driven world.

The company’s operating model is designed to balance focus and agility at the business level with
the structure, oversight, and accountability expected of a global public company.

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a

  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.

  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

Get started


## IT-Security managed
## in Köln

**Wir sind Experten für IT-Sicherheitslösungen. Managed Security Service Provider.
TÜV-zertifizierter Anbieter von Cyber Security Awareness Trainings.** Kurz: Ihr Partner für
umfassende IT-Security. Mit einem breiten Portfolio an monatlich kündbaren UTM-Lösungen über Cyber
Security Awareness bis hin zu ganzheitlichen IT-Sicherheitskonzepten bieten wir für jede
Unternehmensgröße den passenden IT-Schutz.

[Mehr dazu][44]

Die NIS2-Richtlinie verschärft die Sicherheitsanforderungen für Unternehmen in kritischen Sektoren,
einschließlich IT-Dienstleister und Systemhäusern, deutlich. Mit uns setzen IT-Verantwortliche NIS2
sicher und einfach um.

[Mehr dazu][45]
[Drei UTM-Firewalls in unterschiedlichen Größen stehen nebeneinander aufgereiht.]

**Network Box** UTM-Firewalls für jede Unternehmensgröße, mit allen Features wie Anti-Virus,
Anti-Spam, Angriffserkennung und -überwachung. Jede Lösung ist monatlich kündbar, ohne
Investitionskosten und inklusive kostenfreiem Managed Service.

[Mehr dazu][46]
[Ein weißer Kreis auf schwarzem Hintergrund. In dem hellen Kreis hält ein Mensch seine Hand mit
Daumen hoch.]
[Mehr dazu][47]

**Security Awareness Trainings:** Mit Phishing-Simulationen und eLearnings sensibilisieren wir
Mitarbeitende für den richtigen Umgang mit E-Mails, Zugängen und Daten. Als einziger Anbieter von
Anfang bis Ende als Managed Service inkl. Projektdurchführung.

[Mehr dazu][48]
[Logo von With Secure in schwarz auf hellgrauem Hintergrund]

**Withsecure **Wir schützen Ihre Endgeräte und Microsoft 365 vor Bedrohungen wie Ransomware oder
Datenschutzverletzungen in Kooperation mit Withsecure Microsoft Office 365 Cloud Protection, Premium
Server & Endpoint Protection und Rapid Detection & Response.

[Mehr dazu][49]
[Laptop steht halb aufgeklappt auf einem Tisch. Der Hintergrund das Bildes ist dunkel, der
Bildschirm des Laptops leuchtet blau-rot.]
[Mehr dazu][50]

**Dark Web Monitoring** Werden Ihre Daten im Dark Web verkauft? Unsere Suchmaschinen scannen das
Dark Web und informieren Sie proaktiv bei einem Breach. So können Sie rechtzeitig reagieren und Ihr
Unternehmen vor unbefugtem Zugriff schützen.

[Mehr dazu][51]
[Ein Mann mit Brille schaut auf einen Laptop. Neben ihm steht ein anderer Mann und erklärt ihm
etwas. Beide blicken auf den Bildschirm.]

**IT-Security Consulting** Unsere IT-Sicherheitsspezialisten in Köln beraten Sie zu allen Belangen
rund um IT-Sicherheit. Wir erstellen maßgeschneiderte Konzepte, bereiten IT-Verantwortliche auf den
Ernstfall vor und verfügen über jahrelange Erfahrung.

[Mehr dazu][52]
[Logo von Enginsight in schwarz auf hellgrauem Hintergrund]
[Mehr dazu][53]

**Enginsight** In Kooperation mit Enginsight bieten wir Penetrationstests zur Aufdeckung von
IT-Sicherheitslücken an. Sollen Schwachstellen identifiziert werden, erhalten Sie von uns
Handlungsempfehlungen zur Verbesserung der Sicherheit im System.

[Mehr dazu][54]
[Blauer Himmel mit weißen Wolken als Sinnbild für Cloud Security]

Cloud-UTM Die optimale Lösung für kleinere Firmen mit wenig Mitarbeitenden: Mit CBP Connect schützt
ihr eure IT über unsere Cloud-UTM. Hohe Anschaffungs- kosten entfallen. Der Service ist monatlich
kündbar.

[Mehr dazu][55]
[Ein Team von Männer und Frauen sitzt rund um einen Tisch. Jeder hat einen Laptop vor sich. Die Frau
lacht herzlich.]
[Mehr dazu][56]

**Digitaler Ersthelfer** In dieser eLearning Schulung gemeinsam mit DigiTrace lernen Sie, wie Sie
sich auf einen IT-Sicherheitsvorfall vorbereiten und im Ernstfall entweder selbst Ersthilfe leisten
oder konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen aussprechen.

[Mehr dazu][57]

## **Can your OT network guard against the unknown?**

][27]

ARIA Zero Trust PROTECT (AZT PROTECT™) is a comprehensive AI driven defense system that protects all
your OT endpoints from ALL cybersecurity threats – known and unknown.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,
surpassing anything available today. It protects your entire OT device infrastructure and critical
IT applications no matter their location, safeguarding your revenue and reputation. It automatically
blocks virtually all vulnerabilities from exploit at the application and OS level.

[LEARN MORE][28]

[[ARIA AZT PROTECT Image]][29]

[

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

[LEARN MORE][34]

[[ARIA Dashboard with Pie Chart]][35]

ARIA Zero Trust PROTECT (AZT PROTECT™) is a comprehensive AI driven defense system that protects all
your OT endpoints from ALL cybersecurity threats – known and unknown.

This breakthrough patented solution represents a leap forward in the evolution of cybersecurity,
surpassing anything available today. It protects your entire OT device infrastructure and critical
IT applications no matter their location, safeguarding your revenue and reputation. It automatically
blocks virtually all vulnerabilities from exploit at the application and OS level.

[LEARN MORE][28]

[[ARIA AZT PROTECT Image]][29]

[

### **A Better Approach to Cyber-Attack Detection, Response, and Containment**

][30]
[[Cyber Security Expert]][31]

We took a different path when developing our threat detection and response solutions. Unlike other
providers, we monitor all the network traffic and generate analytics to enable complete
enterprise-wide visibility.

This helps our solutions assist in the identification and disruption of attacks in two important
ways: improve the performance of your existing security stack or deploy automated and full AI-driven
SOC capabilities within a single platform. Customers in a range of industries rely on our solutions
to improve their security posture—no matter their environment.

[Learn More][32]
[

### **AI-SOC Run From the Cloud or On-Premise – The Choice is Yours**

][33]

Our ARIA CloudADR solution is a fully AI-automated, cloud-based virtual SOC that provides an
attractive entry point for companies that need to protect both on-premises and public cloud
infrastructure for pennies on the dollar compared to running a physical SOC. Any ARIA CloudADR can
be upgraded to a full ARIA ADR solution with the deployment of a network-attached platform capable
of detecting and stopping all types of network-borne threats and attacks involving the premises

Both solutions include the equivalent functionality of seven different security tools, all of which
are replaced by more advanced ML-based threat detection models driven by AI. As a result, only
confirmed threats and/or cyber-attacks are presented and stopped in minutes as they become
active—all without human involvement.

[LEARN MORE][34]

[[ARIA Dashboard with Pie Chart]][35]

## Resources

detection, response, and remediation solution - ARIA Advanced Detection and Response (ADR). ARIA ADR
is a SOC in a Box that costs 90% less and requires 1/100 of the manpower of a traditional SOC. It's
a smart solution with ML and AI built-in and it can be operated anywhere. View ][36]

# Best IP Intercom System With No Limits & 3 Year Warranty

## What Are IP Intercoms?

All household devices are evolving. Even a conservative market like intercom systems hasn’t been
left behind.

IP intercoms (intercom over IP or internet-based intercom) are intercom systems that harness IP
technology (Internet Protocol technology) allowing users to interface with the building’s local
network over Wi-Fi, opening up a range of security and convenience possibilities.

### Possibilities

Our wired intercom systems are easily connected using Ethernet (Cat5e,Cat6 /UTP5, UTP6), while our
wireless systems utilize Wi-Fi for seamless connectivity. Our intercoms work flawlessly in both
configurations and can be integrated into existing local networks within a building. With BAS-IP,
there are virtually unlimited on the number of door stations, entry panels, or simultaneous calls
within a single system. Programming can be done locally from the intercom monitor or through
specialized BAS-IP software.

### Simplicity

BAS-IP offers nearly limitless options when it comes to building your IP video intercom system. As a
highly specialized company, we focus on expanding our model range, software, and functionality
within a single product group, without venturing into unrelated markets. Our IP intercom systems
come with a wide array of features, which you can explore in detail in our dedicated section.

### High Protection

Our team of experts prioritizes not only convenience and functionality but also the safety,
reliability, and protection of our equipment. All BAS-IP software is developed in-house and
undergoes regular security audits to ensure the highest levels of protection against external
threats.

## Why Is BAS-IP Better

BAS-IP is an esteemed international technology enterprise, specializing in the development and
production of IP video intercom products, access control systems, and communication solutions. Our
robust intercom systems are designed to withstand the elements, making them suitable for outdoor
use.

Established in the UK in 2008, BAS-IP has since grown to employ over 50 talented individuals.

Our premier IP intercoms utilize the SIP protocol, earning us the reputation as a SIP intercom (SIP
intercom system) or VoIP intercom system provider. All our intercom devices are powered via PoE,
making BAS-IP systems genuinely POE intercom systems. Crafted with top-grade materials, our intercom
housing is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use in various weather conditions.

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

Published Oct. 30, 2025
[ [Phil Harvey's headshot] ][27]
[Phil Harvey][28] Editor-in-Chief

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

4. #### Pricing Sovereignty

you.

We have a no-nonsense approach to our customers. Our outcome is to help you get yours!


Choosing the right technology and supplier is not only daunting it is also extremely difficult which
is where we come in. We simplify and present your options clearly and in detail.

We offer deep expertise in telecoms. communications, IT, cloud, security, contact center,
Mobile/Esim, Data Center, Unified communications

collaboration, we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity distribution.

## We focus on what matters: Cybersecurity, cloud and network infrastructure

We help you scope, design and deliver the solutions that matter most to your customers, delivering
major revenue gains for your business. Our fundamental building blocks are:

### Cybersecurity

Deliver high-margin cybersecurity solutions that span networks, datacentre infrastructure, cloud
infrastructure, endpoints, and everything in between.

[ Discover Cybersecurity ][83]

### Secure networks

Help your customers connect their mission-critical apps and data and deliver great end-user
experiences with intelligent, secure, high-performance networks.

[ Discover Secure networks ][84]

### Secure cloud

Engage with our expert Cloud business unit to help customers embrace the cloud with confidence,
giving them ease of deployment, security, access and as-a-service delivery model.

[ Discover Secure cloud ][85]

## Vendors who **spark your growth**

We’ve established relationships with the leading cybersecurity, secure networks and secure cloud
vendors. The result? Innovative, secure solutions that deliver fast ROI.

As your customers move their operations and apps to the cloud, they want to know that their IT is as
secure as possible.

We can help you support this transition and give your customers peace of mind with Infinigate Cloud
– our expert cloud business unit.
[ Find out more ][87]

## IT services that **drive your business** and revenues

[Gartner predicts 9.4% year-on-year increase ][88]in spending on IT services in 2025. Are you ready
to seize this major revenue opportunity?

We have the skills and resources you need to boost your services revenues. We’ll help you select the
right services and support to complete your delivery capabilities.

If you want to upskill your teams and develop your own services capabilities, we deliver a range of
vendor-accredited training.

* Scale up your services capabilities rapidly – allowing you to bid for and win larger services

What is the InfoMSP directory?

The InfoMSP directory is the world’s largest verified database of Managed Service Providers (MSPs)
and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), covering 150,000+ companies and 2M+ decision-maker
contacts across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM.

How often is the MSP data updated?

Every record is re-validated every 45 days. We provide weekly data refreshes to ensure you always
have accurate, up-to-date contact information with minimal bounces.

Can I filter MSPs by IT service or technology partner?

Yes. Use our hyper-granular filters to narrow down by 20+ IT services, 30+ technology vendors

We provide 2M+ verified emails and direct dials for CIOs, IT directors, channel chiefs, and other

End-to-end security engineering and consulting with expert teams, from design to implementation.
* Business continuity and disaster recovery

* Risk assessment and vulnerability management
* Strategic consulting and process management
* Compliance and regulatory consulting
* Artificial intelligence and automation

Details ][184][

### Advanced Support

Uninterrupted operational excellence with SLA-based on-site and remote support.
* On-site and remote support
* Regular maintenance support
* Configuration support
* SLA-based incident response
* Managed services
* 24/7 SOC alert monitoring

### Managed Detection & Response (MDR)

A managed service that detects and stops threats within minutes using our 24/7 SOC, XDR/EDR

* 24/7 detection
* Threat hunting
* Analyst triage
* Guided response
* SLA & reporting
* XDR/EDR integration

Details ][186][

### Threat Intelligence (CTI)

Outside-in intelligence through brand/reputation monitoring, dark web and data-leak detection,
phishing and OSINT.
* Brand & reputation monitoring
* Dark web & leaks
* Phishing/lookalike domains
* OSINT
* IOC & actor intel
* Executive (VIP) protection

An integrated portfolio that protects each layer with its own expertise.

[

### Network Security

Visibility and control at every layer of network traffic, from perimeter to core.
* Network security management
* Anti-ransomware solutions
* DNS/DHCP security

All solutions ][188][

### Information Security

Intelligent security operations, from event correlation to user behavior analytics.
* Security information and event management (SIEM)
* Security automation
* Security configuration and compliance

All solutions ][189][

### Data Security

End-to-end data protection, from data classification to leak prevention.
* Configuration management
* URL/content filtering and gateway
* Data classification

Multi-layered email protection against phishing, BEC and account takeover.
* Anti-phishing & anti-spam
* BEC & impersonation protection
* Malicious attachment & URL analysis (sandbox)

Zero Trust architecture with CASB, CNAPP and IAM in a multi-cloud world.
* Cloud and virtualization security
* Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
* Cloud Native Application Protection (CNAPP)

### Application Security

Protection at every stage of the software lifecycle, from DevSecOps to API security.
* Application security solutions

management to provide a seamless, fully managed security experience.

### Explore the Blueprint of Success

Business Model Canvas Templates
* **Unlock Strategic Insights**
  Dive deep into the core of what makes businesses tick. Our business model canvas templates provide
  a clear and concise framework for understanding the intricate elements that contribute to a
  company's success. From startups to global corporations, these templates encapsulate diverse
  business strategies and operational tactics, empowering you to unlock strategic insights quickly.
* **Immediate Access and Usability**
  Time is of the essence in today's fast-paced business environment. Get instant access to our
  templates in both Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word formats right after your purchase. These
  familiar, user-friendly platforms ensure that you can start adapting and analyzing the canvases to
  your needs without any delay or additional software requirements.
* **A Broad Spectrum of Industries**
  Whether you're interested in technology, healthcare, retail, or any other sector, our extensive
  library covers a vast range of industries and business models. This diversity enables
  entrepreneurs, students, and consultants to find relevant models that resonate with their specific
  industry challenges and learning objectives.
* **Designed for Practical Application**
  Our business model canvases are more than just theoretical concepts; they are practical tools
  designed to be directly applied to your business planning and strategic development. Use them as a
  starting point to map out your new venture, understand competitive environments, or teach business
  principles with real-world applications.
* **No-Risk Exploration**
  With our no-refund policy, we encourage you to make informed decisions. Browse detailed
  descriptions and samples available on our website to ensure that our products align with your
  needs before making a purchase. Our customer support team is always ready to answer any queries
  and help guide your selection process.

### FAQs

[ What exactly is included in each business model canvas package? ][47]

Each business model canvas package includes a comprehensive layout of the business model for a
real-life company. The package is available in both Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word formats,
allowing you to view and edit the canvas to suit your needs. The canvases cover various components
such as value propositions, customer segments, revenue streams, key activities, key resources, key
partnerships, cost structure, and customer relationships.

[ How can I use these business model canvases for my own business or academic purposes? ][48]

Our business model canvas templates are designed to serve as a valuable learning tool for
entrepreneurs, business students, and consultants. You can use these canvases to understand the key
components of successful business models, analyze competitive strategies, or as a template to
develop your own business model. For educational purposes, they provide practical insights into
real-world business strategies and operations.

[ What is the cost of each business model canvas, and what payment options are available? ][49]

Each individual business model canvas is priced at a flat rate. We accept one-time payments with no
subscriptions required. You can purchase canvases individually, and all major credit cards and
payment services are accepted. Detailed pricing information is available on our pricing page.

[ How quickly can I access the business model canvas after purchase? ][50]

All business model canvas templates are available for immediate download once your purchase is
completed. You will receive a secure link to download the files in both Microsoft Excel and
Microsoft Word formats directly to your device, enabling instant access to the information you need
without any waiting period.

[ What is your refund policy for the business model canvases? ][51]

Due to the digital nature of our business model canvas templates and their immediate intellectual
property value upon download, we do not offer refunds once a purchase has been made. We encourage
customers to review the descriptions and samples available on our website carefully before making a
purchase to ensure it meets their needs. If you have any questions or concerns prior to purchasing,
please feel free to contact our support team for assistance.

### FAQs

[ What exactly is included in each business model canvas package? ][47]

Each business model canvas package includes a comprehensive layout of the business model for a
real-life company. The package is available in both Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word formats,
allowing you to view and edit the canvas to suit your needs. The canvases cover various components
such as value propositions, customer segments, revenue streams, key activities, key resources, key
partnerships, cost structure, and customer relationships.

[ How can I use these business model canvases for my own business or academic purposes? ][48]

Our business model canvas templates are designed to serve as a valuable learning tool for
entrepreneurs, business students, and consultants. You can use these canvases to understand the key
components of successful business models, analyze competitive strategies, or as a template to
develop your own business model. For educational purposes, they provide practical insights into
real-world business strategies and operations.

[ What is the cost of each business model canvas, and what payment options are available? ][49]

Each individual business model canvas is priced at a flat rate. We accept one-time payments with no
subscriptions required. You can purchase canvases individually, and all major credit cards and
payment services are accepted. Detailed pricing information is available on our pricing page.

[ How quickly can I access the business model canvas after purchase? ][50]

All business model canvas templates are available for immediate download once your purchase is
completed. You will receive a secure link to download the files in both Microsoft Excel and
Microsoft Word formats directly to your device, enabling instant access to the information you need
without any waiting period.

[ What is your refund policy for the business model canvases? ][51]

Due to the digital nature of our business model canvas templates and their immediate intellectual
property value upon download, we do not offer refunds once a purchase has been made. We encourage
customers to review the descriptions and samples available on our website carefully before making a
purchase to ensure it meets their needs. If you have any questions or concerns prior to purchasing,
please feel free to contact our support team for assistance.

# Your closest ally
# in cyber security

##### The sovereign security platform for lean European defenders

Your data. Your deployment. Your jurisdiction.

For the European organisations who protect society — energy, healthcare, public services, and the
partners who serve them.

[Get a demo][83]
Trusted by the organisations who guard Europe’s critical infrastructure

## In it together.
## Protecting what keeps society running.

Log management. Compliance reporting. Audit evidence. The work that proves an organisation
operates the way it says it does.

Behind that work are people: the analysts reviewing access logs. The GRC leaders preparing for the
next audit. The IT teams answering the regulator's questions. The healthcare administrators checking
who looked at which record, and why.

Our job is to make their work simpler, faster, and easier to prove. To give them the evidence they
need, in the form they need it, under their own control.

You keep hospitals, power grids, water supplies, and the businesses Europe depends on running
properly. We help you show it — every day and on your terms.

TOUCH
TOUCH
TOUCH

## Data sovereignty removes cloud dependency risk

Cloud-first security shifts control away from defenders while leaving accountability behind.
Guardsix closes that gap by giving its allies full control over their data, deployment, and
operations.
Control your security data

Keep data, access, and evidence fully under your authority. Maintain control during incidents and
prove it during audits.

Operate security on your terms

Run security workflows that fit your environment, not vendor constraints. Operate without
bottlenecks or specialist dependencies.

Deploy without constraints

Avoid forced cloud adoption and retain full control over your infrastructure. Choose where and how
your security solutions run.

Optimise security economics

Break free from ingestion-based pricing and hidden cost drivers. Scale coverage without sacrificing
visibility or exceeding budget.

## Guardsix Command Centre

The sovereign security platform built for Europe's hidden defenders.

1
Stay audit-ready by design
2
Assert control over your own data
3
Full visibility without ingestion surprises
4
Multi-tenant visibility and control

# MSPs for the Protection of Critical Infrastructure

[ Contact Us ][26]
[MSPCollective_secure-2]

### Secure our
### Critical
### Infrastructure

[MSPCollective_support-2]

### Support
### Critical Infrastructure Industries

[MSPCollective_improve-2]

### Improve
### National
### Security

## OUR MISSION

To inform the US Government and Critical Infrastructure industries on topics related to Managed
Service Providers (MSP) and Managed Security Service  Providers (MSSP) dedicated to the National
Security mission of maintaining a secure, functioning, and resilient critical infrastructure.

## AS A COLLECTIVE

We desire to collaborate as an industry advisory group to Congress, DoD, the Cyber AB, and state
legislatures to provide insight into the importance of external service providers in securing
critical infrastructure, the federal contracting base, and especially the Defense Industrial Base .

[MSPCollective_shapes_Standards-03]

## Standards

As a collective, we believe in identifying minimum requirements for External Service Provider (ESPs)
that exceed the minimum requirements for CUI protection as defined in DFARS 252.204-7012 / NIST SP
800-171.
* A NIST SP 800-53 Tailored Baseline for ESPs
* Suggested changes to standards such as SP 800-171, 800-171A, 800-172 and 800-172A

## Appropriations

We understand that proposals that have been submitted to Congress which include DoD appropriations
for grants to DIB members to offset the necessary one-time investment in getting the DIB to CMMC
compliance. The MSP Collective supports this effort and will continually seek new ways to support
critical infastructure
* Advocate for small businesses in the DIB

[MSPCollective_shapes_Appropriations]
[MSPCollective_shapes_Standards-01]

## Certifications

Through involvement in the CyberAB and CMMC program, our collective has encountered several flaws
that require attention to strengthen the DIB and their adjoining atmosphere. **Making sure critical
infrastructure remains:**
* Operational
* Safe
* Resilient

A Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) delivers outsourced security monitoring, threat
detection, and incident response on behalf of your organization. MSSPs operate security operations
centers (SOCs) that provide 24/7 visibility into your environment, so your team doesn't have to
build and staff one internally.

Getting Started

## How to Choose an MSSP

1

### Define Your Requirements

Identify what security services you need: MDR, SIEM management, compliance support, or full SOC
outsourcing. Not sure where to start? Learn [what managed security service providers do][25] and
consider your industry regulations and company size. Document the gaps in your current security
program and rank them by business risk. For example, if you lack after-hours monitoring, 24/7
coverage should be near the top. If you face specific compliance mandates like HIPAA or PCI DSS,
note those early because they will narrow your shortlist. Browse providers by [service category][26]
to see which capabilities are most commonly offered.

2

### Evaluate Capabilities

Look at each provider's technology stack, certifications, SLA guarantees, and industry expertise.
Ensure they support your existing security tools. See our guide to the [best MSSP providers in
2026][27]. Ask whether the MSSP has experience with your specific [security platforms][28], because
onboarding goes faster when the provider already knows your tooling. Verify certifications like SOC
2 Type II, ISO 27001, or industry-specific credentials that demonstrate operational maturity.
Request sample incident reports so you can evaluate how clearly the provider communicates findings
and recommended actions.

3

### Compare & Decide

Request proposals from your shortlist. Compare pricing models, response time SLAs, and references
from similar organizations in your industry. Pay close attention to contract length, termination
clauses, and how pricing scales as your environment grows. Ask each finalist for customer references
in your [industry][29] and at a similar [company size][30], then follow up with those references
about onboarding timelines, alert quality, and how responsive the MSSP is during active incidents.

[Read the full buyer's guide][31]

Budgeting

## What Does an MSSP Cost?

MSSP pricing varies widely depending on the services included, the size of your environment, and the
level of customization you require. Most providers use one of three pricing models: per-device or
per-endpoint fees, per-user pricing, or flat monthly retainers that bundle a defined set of
services. Some MSSPs also charge based on data ingestion volume, particularly for SIEM management,
which means your log sources and event volume directly affect your monthly bill.

Based on current market data, small businesses with under 100 employees typically pay $2,000 to
$5,000 per month for basic managed detection and monitoring. Mid-market organizations (100 to 1,000
employees) commonly fall in the $5,000 to $25,000 per month range, depending on scope. Large
enterprises with complex, multi-cloud environments and compliance requirements often spend $25,000
or more per month. These ranges shift based on factors like 24/7 versus business-hours-only
coverage, the number of [service categories][32] included, and whether incident response retainer
hours are part of the contract. Organizations shopping by [company size][33] can use these
benchmarks as a starting point for budget conversations.

The biggest cost drivers are analyst headcount (24/7 SOC coverage requires multiple shifts of
skilled staff), the breadth of your technology stack, and compliance complexity. Adding services
like vulnerability management, penetration testing, or dedicated threat hunting will increase the
price. Before signing, make sure you understand what is and is not included in the base fee, because
overage charges for incident response hours or additional log sources can add up quickly.

benchmarks as a starting point for budget conversations.

The biggest cost drivers are analyst headcount (24/7 SOC coverage requires multiple shifts of
skilled staff), the breadth of your technology stack, and compliance complexity. Adding services
like vulnerability management, penetration testing, or dedicated threat hunting will increase the
price. Before signing, make sure you understand what is and is not included in the base fee, because
overage charges for incident response hours or additional log sources can add up quickly.

## What Services Does Opsio Provide?

End-to-end managed services tailored to your business needs — from infrastructure operations to AI
implementation.

### Managed Infrastructure Services

Opsio provides round-the-clock monitoring, optimization, and management of your infrastructure
across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Our dedicated teams handle patching, incident response, and
capacity planning so your engineers can focus on building products instead of maintaining servers.
Clients typically see a 40% reduction in unplanned downtime within the first quarter.

[Explore Managed Infrastructure Services →][22]

### Migration & Modernization

We help businesses move workloads to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud with minimal downtime and zero data
loss. Our structured approach covers assessment, 6R strategy selection, wave planning, and
post-migration optimization. With over 2,000 workloads migrated, we deliver transitions that are
faster and less disruptive than industry averages.

[Explore Migration & Modernization →][23]

### DevOps & Automation

Opsio builds CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and GitOps workflows that
accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining governance. We implement Terraform modules,
Kubernetes deployment strategies, and automated testing pipelines tailored to your team.
Organizations we work with typically see a 3-5x increase in deployment frequency.

[Explore DevOps & Automation →][24]

### Security & Compliance

We build zero-trust architectures with identity governance, SIEM/SOC integration, and continuous
compliance monitoring. Our team helps organizations meet ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, and HIPAA
requirements through automated policy enforcement and audit-ready configurations. We design
compliant systems from day one rather than retrofitting after deployment.

[Explore Security & Compliance →][25]

### Data & AI

From MLOps platforms and predictive maintenance to computer vision and intelligent document
processing, Opsio delivers enterprise AI solutions tailored to specific business problems. We build
RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration layers, and data lake architectures that turn raw data into
actionable intelligence. Recent projects have reduced manual review time by 70% for our clients.

[Explore Data & AI →][26]

### Shield

Proactive threat detection, penetration testing, load testing, and social engineering assessments to
protect your business from evolving threats. Our Shield program provides end-to-end security
operations including vulnerability scanning, red team exercises, and continuous monitoring. We
identify risks before attackers do and help you build resilient defenses.

[Explore Shield →][27]

Opsio is a managed services provider headquartered in Karlstad, Sweden, with a delivery center in
Bangalore, India. Founded in 2022, Opsio provides 24/7 managed infrastructure across [Amazon Web
Services][17], [Microsoft Azure][18], and [Google Cloud Platform][19]. The company holds AWS
Advanced Partner status and employs over 50 certified professionals who have completed more than
3,000 projects across Europe and Asia. Core services include infrastructure management, migration,
DevOps automation, security and [ISO 27001][20]/[NIST][21] compliance, FinOps cost optimization, and
enterprise AI implementation. Clients typically achieve 30-40% reduction in infrastructure spending
through Opsio's FinOps practices.

## What Services Does Opsio Provide?

End-to-end managed services tailored to your business needs — from infrastructure operations to AI
implementation.

### Managed Infrastructure Services

Opsio provides round-the-clock monitoring, optimization, and management of your infrastructure
across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Our dedicated teams handle patching, incident response, and
capacity planning so your engineers can focus on building products instead of maintaining servers.
Clients typically see a 40% reduction in unplanned downtime within the first quarter.

[Explore Managed Infrastructure Services →][22]

### Migration & Modernization

We help businesses move workloads to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud with minimal downtime and zero data
loss. Our structured approach covers assessment, 6R strategy selection, wave planning, and
post-migration optimization. With over 2,000 workloads migrated, we deliver transitions that are
faster and less disruptive than industry averages.

[Explore Migration & Modernization →][23]

### DevOps & Automation

Opsio builds CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and GitOps workflows that
accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining governance. We implement Terraform modules,
Kubernetes deployment strategies, and automated testing pipelines tailored to your team.
Organizations we work with typically see a 3-5x increase in deployment frequency.

[Explore DevOps & Automation →][24]

### Security & Compliance

We build zero-trust architectures with identity governance, SIEM/SOC integration, and continuous
compliance monitoring. Our team helps organizations meet ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, and HIPAA
requirements through automated policy enforcement and audit-ready configurations. We design
compliant systems from day one rather than retrofitting after deployment.

[Explore Security & Compliance →][25]

### Data & AI

From MLOps platforms and predictive maintenance to computer vision and intelligent document
processing, Opsio delivers enterprise AI solutions tailored to specific business problems. We build
RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration layers, and data lake architectures that turn raw data into
actionable intelligence. Recent projects have reduced manual review time by 70% for our clients.

[Explore Data & AI →][26]

### Shield

Proactive threat detection, penetration testing, load testing, and social engineering assessments to
protect your business from evolving threats. Our Shield program provides end-to-end security
operations including vulnerability scanning, red team exercises, and continuous monitoring. We
identify risks before attackers do and help you build resilient defenses.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

FAQ

## You ask, we answer

Cloud Services
Cyber Security
Data Center Solutions
Digital Transformation
End User Computing
IMS
What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

THE SECUREOPS DIFFERENCE

## What Sets SecureOps Apart as a Boutique MSSP

Our experience as a "boutique" managed security services provider (MSSP) with proven, flexible,
security-by-design services goes beyond ordinary. It makes us uniquely qualified to grow your
security maturity and optimize any tools in your cybersecurity tech stack.

Commercial and enterprise companies use our expertise and global managed security services to: 
* Enable 24/7, co-owned MDR and custom SOC operations
* Strengthen their first line of defense with infrastructure security
* Stop threats with vulnerability management

[Learn about our services][3][What makes us different][4]

## Proven MSSP Results: Retention, Response, Security Maturity

THAT'S WHY ...

YOUR SIEM. OUR EXPERTISE.

## Co-Owned MDR: Formalize Detection Processes to Speed Response

You bring your SIEM. SecureOps brings 24/7 monitoring, detection, and response to secure your
digital assets. You own the tools. We bring the expertise and coverage. We update your SIEM with the
latest detection rules and threats. Rather than a sunk cost you don’t get back, MDR becomes an
investment in cyber resilience that grows as you scale.

Our goal is to help you develop formalized threat detection rules and content so you get stronger
security from the systems you own. We work to match your business context and security priorities
with our flexible, security-by-design services.

Andrew Morrison

Senior SOC Manager, SecureOps

OUTSOURCE WHAT YOU NEED TO EXTEND YOUR TEAM

## Custom SOC Services: 24/7 Monitoring, Detection, and Escalation of True Alerts

Outsource exactly what you want. We'll deliver using your tools and processes. Our
security-by-design services protect your critical data and perimeter with our cybersecurity experts
from Level 1 to Level 3. Add detection engineering for a proactive approach to emerging threats with
a rapid response plan to increase your security maturity.

    Our team of experts provide strategic guidance across a wide range of technologies, and are
deeply committed to our customer’s success. We become an extension of your team, standardize your
processes, and help you build the resilience needed to reduce risk and improve your security
posture.

Patrick Ethier

CTO, SecureOps

OPTIMIZE THE TOOLS YOU HAVE

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

[READ THE REPORT][167]

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle

external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

For more FAQs and Help, visit our [Help Center.][72]

# **CMMC Certification. Guaranteed.**

SysArc’s **[CMMC Readiness OS™][57]** provides defense contractors (100-1,000+ employees) with a
clear, co-managed path to achieving and maintaining CMMC Level 2 compliance. Follow our plan and
achieve certification. Guaranteed.

[Learn More ][58] [Get a Consultation ][59]

## **Your Outcome is our Mission**

Since 2004, SysArc has been the trusted technology partner that designs, builds, and operates
secure, compliant IT solutions—guaranteeing CMMC audit success—so your business can simplify cyber
compliance, align technology with goals, and unlock its full growth potential.
* ## **21**
  
  Years designing, building and operating Secure Networks for the Aerospace and Defense Indusrty
* ## **9**
  
  Years focused on assisting the Defense Industrial Base with NIST 800-171 and CMMC Compliance
* ## **1500+**
  
  DIB Suppliers SysArc has advised during their CMMC journey
* ## **15 for 15**
  
  Customers successfully passing their CMMC audit with a score of 110
* ## **1**
  
  of only a handful of Service Providers with the expertise and experience that can provide an
  end-to-end solution to ensure CMMC compliance

## **Our Services**

Award-Winning Managed IT & Security Services.
* #### CMMC Readiness OS™
  
  An audit-ready CMMC operating system for DoD contractors. Follow our plan and achieve
  certification. Guaranteed.
  
  [Learn More ][60]
* #### Managed Cyber Security
  
  An advanced set of people, processes, tools & intelligence combined to monitor, detect, analyze,
  remediate and report on the threats to your information systems.
  
  [Learn More ][61]
* #### IT Risk Management & Compliance
  
  Gap Analysis, Remediation and Ongoing Monitoring & Incident Response for industry compliance with
  CMMC, DFARS, NIST 800-171, GDPR, PCI, FISMA, FedRamp.
  
  [Learn More ][62]
* #### CMMC/DFARS Compliance Solutions
  
  We help DoD Prime Contractors and Subcontractors become compliant with CMMC/DFARS in accordance
  with NIST 800-171. From assessments to everything you need to comply — we do it all.
  
  [Learn More ][63]
* [Managed IT Support]
  
  #### Managed IT Services
  
  Stay ahead and ensure that you have a strong support system in place to deal with those unexpected
  (and sometimes unavoidable) IT nightmares.
  
  [Learn More ][64]
* [GCC High Migration Services]
  
  #### GCC/GCC High Migration Services
  
  As an approved reseller of Microsoft GCC/GCC High, we’ve helped hundreds of companies navigate the
  complexities of migrating their current working environment over to GCC/GCC High — significantly
  strengthening their IT security and getting them closer to compliance with CMMC.
  
  [Learn More ][65]
* [GCC High Migration Services]
  
  #### SOC as a Service
  
  Our Security Operations Center (SOC) protects your company’s assets 24/7 and responds to immediate
  cyber threats so you can focus on running and growing your business.
  
  [Learn More ][66]
* [GCC High Migration Services]
  
  #### Managed IT Services for GovCon
  
  We understand the unique challenges of companies in the GovCon space — from bidding on new work to
  onboarding/offboarding staff to collaborating with teaming partners and dealing with compliance
  issues and audit requirements.
  
  [Learn More ][67]

## **Case Studies**
